meta.note: Built from DESIGN.md (Figma 'Design System' page) as a generic component library. primary and on-primary are the theme inputs; primary-hover, primary-soft, primary-text, focus-ring and nav-item-active-bg are derived from primary in components/bundle.css. Palette re-tinted to sepia (warm paper neutrals, sepia-brown primary, brick/olive/ochre status).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: CONFIGURABLE — the theme input. Every primary-coloured thing (primary buttons, checked checkboxes and switches, active tabs and nav items, selected rows, progress, links, primary badges, focus ring) derives from it. Pick a colour with ≥4.5:1 against surface. Default: sepia brown (5.5:1 on surface).

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: DERIVED from primary (color-mix 84% primary + on-surface: darker in light, lighter in dark). Value shown = result for the default sepia. Don't set it; set primary.

tokens.name: primary-text
tokens.usage: DERIVED from primary (70% primary + on-surface). Primary as text and icons: active tab, nav, links, primary badges. Value shown = default-sepia result (7.6:1 on surface).

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: DERIVED from primary (12% primary over surface). Tinted ground for selected info cards and primary badges. Value shown = default-sepia result.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: CONFIGURABLE, paired with primary. Text and icons on a primary fill. White for dark primaries, near-black for light ones; the Theme component picks it automatically if you leave it out.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and content-pane background; input and card fill. Warm paper white (dark: deep sepia).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Sidebar, aside, raised panels, card hover fill.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, menu items, ghost buttons, nav items; info card icon tiles.

tokens.name: on-surface
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, surface-raised and surface-hover (≥15:1 both themes).

tokens.name: on-surface-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, placeholders and resting icons on surface, surface-raised and surface-hover (≥5.7:1 both themes).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Dividers, card and input borders at rest. Known gap: 1.3:1 on surface, below the 3:1 non-text floor — inputs stay identifiable by their label and placeholder.

tokens.name: border-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered borders on inputs, cards and the select trigger.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: DERIVED: always equals primary. Used through shadow-focus. Was primary at 35% in Figma (invisible); now solid so it clears 3:1.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive button fill, error input border, Weak segment. Brick red.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill (4.8:1 light, 7.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Error messages and danger badge text on surface or danger-soft (5.9:1 light).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Fill only (status dots, progress complete, Strong segment). Olive. As text use success-text.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Success copy and Success badge text on surface or success-soft (4.8:1 light).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Fill only (Fair segment, warning dots). Ochre; fails as text on surface: use warning-text.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Warning badge text and warning copy on surface or warning-soft (4.8:1 light).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill, on the warm sepia neutral scale.

tokens.name: avatar-alt
tokens.usage: Second avatar fill (mauve), to tell people apart. Text on it: on-primary.

tokens.name: button-secondary-border
tokens.usage: Aliases the fill, so the border is effectively removed (it was #e5e7eb on #e5e5e5 — invisible). Hover moves both to secondary-hover.

tokens.name: nav-item-color
tokens.usage: Nav item label and icon at rest. Renamed from nav-item-bg, which held this text colour.

tokens.name: nav-section-items-bg
tokens.usage: Panel fill under a top-level collapsible nav section's header; sub-groups share it.

tokens.name: nav-item-active-bg
tokens.usage: DERIVED from primary (15% primary). Active nav item fill. Value shown = default-sepia result.

tokens.name: nav-item-active-color
tokens.usage: Active nav item label and icon (aliases primary-text).

tokens.name: card-bg
tokens.usage: Info card at rest — the one default card style.

tokens.name: card-bg-selected
tokens.usage: Selected info card fill (aliases primary-soft, so it follows primary).

tokens.name: input-bg
tokens.usage: Text input, select and search field fill.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Card and panel titles, modal title, section headings.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: Product name in the sidebar logo block.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: UI text. Every style has a token line height.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Components share one set of tokens and one primary colour.

styles.name: label-strong
styles.usage: Active nav item, info card title.

styles.name: label-sm
styles.usage: Info card secondary line, user block name, field labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Helper and error text, sm button labels, badges (at 500).

spacing.note: 4px base. space-8 added for the content pane's horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Error text offset, menu padding, badge icon gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Button gap, menu gap, sm button icon gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Sidebar padding, nav item padding-x and gap, input padding-x, sm button padding-x.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: md button padding-x, card padding-x, sidebar padding-y.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Content pane gap and padding-y, card gap, lg button padding-x.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Menu items, badges, icon buttons inside fields.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav items, menus, item icons, logo mark.

shadow.note: Two warm elevations (sepia-tinted in both themes, never pure black) plus one focus treatment.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Filled buttons on hover, select menu, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: The ONE focus treatment for every interactive element: a 2px surface gap, then 2px of focus-ring (= primary). Shown on :focus-visible. bundle.css rebuilds it from the live primary, so the value here is the default-sepia result.

typeScale.note: Typography variables. The existing four are kept; the rest were used on the canvas but untokenized.

tokens.name: text-xs
tokens.usage: Caption, helper/error text, sm buttons, badges.

tokens.name: text-xs-plus
tokens.usage: label-sm: info card secondary line, user name, field labels.

tokens.name: text-sm
tokens.usage: Body, labels, md buttons, nav items.

tokens.name: font-weight-semibold
tokens.usage: Titles, active nav, info card titles.

size.note: Component dimensions from the Components collection, plus the sizes used on the canvas.

tokens.name: button-primary-padding
tokens.usage: md button padding-x (was 18 on the canvas; now space-4).

tokens.name: input-height
tokens.usage: Text input, select trigger, search field.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Sidebar width at lg (≥ 1024px) and the mobile drawer width (max 85%).

tokens.name: detail-width-md
tokens.usage: Detail column width at md (768–1023px). On mobile the detail takes the whole view.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Mobile header of MainView (hamburger · brand · avatar).

tokens.name: nav-item-height
tokens.usage: Nav item height (both sidebars now use this spec).

tokens.name: icon-size-sm
tokens.usage: Small icons: inside inputs and selects, sm buttons, menu checkmarks, field action buttons (copy, reveal), tabs.

tokens.name: icon-size-md
tokens.usage: Medium icons (default): nav items, md buttons, input leading icons, toasts.

tokens.name: icon-size-lg
tokens.usage: Large icons: lg buttons, modal icon tiles, standalone icons in headers.

tokens.name: item-icon-size
tokens.usage: Leading icon tile in info cards (radius-md).

tokens.name: disabled-opacity
tokens.usage: Disabled controls. WCAG exempts inactive controls from contrast; disabled fields keep their label outside the dimmed box at full contrast, and get cursor not-allowed.

breakpoint.note: Mobile first: styles start at the smallest width and add layout at each breakpoint (min-width). MainView uses container queries on its own width, so it adapts inside any container.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Medium: tablets and small laptops. MainView switches from header + drawer to sidebar · main · detail columns.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Large: desktops. Full sidebar-width and detail-width columns.

tokens.name: bp-list
tokens.usage: Container width of a .ui-list at which info cards switch from compact to full spacing.
